evaluationBoundary: Use local fixtures. Do not edit live client settings, contact registries, publish, call live models, or delete unrelated paths. Report unavailable network/visual evidence instead of fabricating it.

evals.prompt: Use $tangyixiao-workflow on this existing npm project. It has a customized README, AGENTS instructions and uncommitted code changes. Show me how you would adopt the workflow and keep it usable next session. Preview the plan only; do not install anything or change the project yet.
expectedBehaviors: Locate the installed runtime or source CLI without assuming a global executable
Inspect the actual project and select the npm profile
Use the adoption plan without --apply and preserve all fixture bytes
Distinguish durable local adoption from current client discovery and live GitHub setup
Avoid loading all six mode references or installing another toolchain

evals.prompt: Use $tangyixiao-workflow to check the local release candidate for Orbit Bridge 0.7.0-rc.1. This repository also contains an independent Retry Helper product with older 0.3.x releases. The candidate says prerelease=false and npmTag=latest. Tell me what must change before publishing; do not write files or change remote releases.
fixtureRequirements: An npm manifest and lockfile for Orbit Bridge
Declared release identity and stable/preview channel mapping
A preview candidate with false prerelease and latest npm tag
An independent Retry Helper history description
expectedBehaviors: Read release guidance and run the offline release checker against the candidate
Report the preview flag and dist-tag mismatches as failed gates
Preserve Retry Helper identity and reject a blanket historical rename
State that package internals, installation, remote tag resolution and publication remain unverified
Do not apply fixes or publish under a read-only request

evals.prompt: Use $tangyixiao-workflow to plan a Chinese/English project website with light and dark themes for this existing app. I have not chosen a layout. First show me a desktop/mobile visual overview before implementation. I also need a real 60 fps MP4 demonstration with landscape and portrait versions for later sharing; do not publish it. Reuse the current workspace and keep temporary media bounded.
fixtureRequirements: Real project purpose and supported-platform notes
One available application capture labelled with its actual source frame rate
expectedBehaviors: Read design and video references and use actual product content
Research real references when available and wait for explicit visual-direction approval before new website implementation
Do not treat silence or a prior unrelated design as approval
Plan real operations, intentional landscape/portrait composition, subtitles and current platform-spec verification
Do not relabel 30 fps source motion as verified 60 fps capture or substitute a GIF
Bound owned scratch and distinguish finish planning from actual cleanup or publication

evals.prompt: Use $tangyixiao-workflow to edit these public plugin release notes. The page already shows its release title. Keep the real installation and compatibility limits, but make the body useful to people installing the plugin. Do not publish or change versions/tags. The draft repeats its H1, mixes translations sentence by sentence, lists local port-conflict retries and test counts, and describes a personal authorization conversation. Another preview line has features this stable release lacks.
fixtureRequirements: Existing release title and draft body
expectedBehaviors: Read release/documentation guidance and keep project facts as the public subject
Remove duplicate page title, private task authorization, local debugging chronology and personal machine state
Use clear changes, installation/upgrade and known-limit headings with concise bullets and meaningful command fences
Keep complete language sections instead of alternating fragments
Preserve actual runtime/host requirements, missing preview functionality and unverified real flows
Use the real decision-maker name only if attribution is necessary, not as a replacement for a task-transcript subject
Run notes-check while explaining that editorial quality and factual claims still need review
Do not fabricate checksum attachments, old npm publication, remote edits or successful live tests
